identification_note: A separate M-U series is not reported: unrestricted risk utility and M-R are observationally equivalent on the win-price schedule. The directly implemented contrast is M-R versus M-S2/M-S3, with raw and discounted Harville as same-race nonbehavioral benchmarks.

time_forward_validation.training_rule: years strictly earlier than the validation year

unordered_external_validation_note: Quinella and trio compare one reduced weighting of the unordered event probability with the sum of two or six ordered sequential claim scores; no arbitrary order is assigned to an unordered pool.
